City of Tampa
Agenda Item Request
Department: Community and Redevelopment Agency
CRA Regular
Submittal Date:                        8/05/2026
Requested Meeting Date: 8/20/2026
Type of Request:                                                  CRA Resolution
ContactMia Dorton 813-274-8643
SubjectDowntown CRA-A Resolution of the Community Redevelopment Agency of 
the City of Tampa, Florida, approving the grant funding agreement for 
construction between the CRA and Jackson House Foundation, Inc., to 
renovate and restore 851 E Zack Street, Tampa
Resolution / 
Ordinance 
Title
Downtown CRA - A Resolution of the Community Redevelopment Agency of 
the City of Tampa, Florida, approving the Grant Funding Agreement for 
construction between the CRA and Jackson House Foundation, Inc., to 
renovate and restore the 4,680 square-foot Jackson House Museum to 
preserve its historic landmark designation at 851 E Zack St, Tampa, FL 
33602, within the boundaries of the Downtown Core Community 
Redevelopment Area; authorizing execution of the Grant Funding Agreement 
by the CRA Chair and attestation by the CRA Secretary; providing an effective 
date."
BACKGROUND:
On April 9, 2026, the Community Redevelopment Agency approved supporting the 
renovations of the historic Jackson House project in the amount of $1 million over a one-year 
fiscal period. Expected enhancements to the community through this project include repairs to 
the foundation, roof, walls, and floors, with careful attention to the historically appropriate 
materials, including brickwork and period-accurate colors.
FISCAL IMPACT: Yes
FISCAL IMPACT STATEMENT:
This resolution provides for a grant funding agreement between the Community 
Redevelopment Agency of the City of Tampa and the Jackson House Foundation, Inc. to 
renovate and restore the Jackson House Museum in the amount of $1,000,000 within the 
Community Redevelopment Agency CRA Non-Core Fund.
